[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Liberal Studies - Education Concentration, B.A.","groupId":"a913793a-c7be-4963-a2a8-0192df0f351a","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

ABOUT THE MAJOR

The liberal studies major is an interdisciplinary major that provides the content background for multiple subject candidates wishing to enter teacher education programs for teaching at the elementary level in the state of California. Additionally, the liberal studies major provides a rounded course of study in the liberal arts appropriate for preparation in numerous vocations.

Students must prepare a senior project in their last semester prior to graduation that is reviewed by undergraduate faculty and professional educators. In addition, students planning to enter the FPU teacher education program must maintain a GPA of 3.0 or better during their baccalaureate program. 


EDUCATION CONCENTRATION

Students in the Education Concentration will complete 13 units of graduate-level EDUC courses which will count toward their credential program. See catalog for details.


﻿**Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU**

This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php.
